premises.text: People are hardwired to respond to immediate gratification, which retailers exploit.
premises.evidence_span: our brain was designed 50,000 years ago to be good at one thing, hunting and gathering.

premises.text: Most Americans spend a significant portion of their disposable income on unnecessary purchases.
premises.evidence_span: Most of us in America are actually spending between 10 and 20 percent of our disposable income on these silly purchases we don't need.

premises.text: Traditional financial advice often fails to help people manage their finances effectively.
premises.evidence_span: experts will tell you and have for a hundred years... that in order to do well with your finances, you must create a plan, you must have a budget.

premises.text: Impulse Save allows users to save money instantly when they choose not to make an impulse purchase.
premises.evidence_span: with a few touches of our mobile app... throwing it back on the rack and not buying it, but have the amount she was just about to have spent be transferred automatically.

premises.text: Users can set personal savings goals that motivate them to save.
premises.evidence_span: they create goals. And a goal can be anything from an iPad, to a travel vacation, to paying down your student debt.

premises.text: Impulse Save incorporates social features that encourage users to share their savings.
premises.evidence_span: close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves.

premises.text: The platform uses notifications and updates to engage users and encourage saving.
premises.evidence_span: We do that through email updates and progress updates. We do that through notifications.

premises.text: Users can save money through various channels, including social media and SMS.
premises.evidence_span: you can impulse save using Instagram. Just use the impulse save hashtag.

value.text: Users can save money easily and effectively through the Impulse Save platform.
value.evidence_span: our savers are saving over $3,000 a year right now.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
